cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
path = 'parsing/html/reader_test.go'
s = open(path).read()
old = '''\tt.Run("dt and dd close each other", func(t *testing.T) {'''
new = '''\tt.Run("option closes option", func(t *testing.T) {
\t\tv := read(t, `<select><option>a<option>b</select>`, false)
\t\toption := mustGetMapKey(t, mustGetMapKey(t, mustGetMapKey(t, v, "body"), "select"), "option")
\t\tif option.Type() != model.TypeSlice {
\t\t\tt.Fatalf("expected slice, got %s", option.Type())
\t\t}
\t})

\tt.Run("dt and dd close each other", func(t *testing.T) {'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(path, 'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w parsing/html/reader_test.go && go test ./parsing/html/ -run TestReader_ImplicitClosing -v 2>&1 | tail -30
